notes.title: Atoners: The Lost Epoch is now part of the Steam Next Fest! Give it a try! 🎮
notes.content:
[h1]Atoners![/h1]

You are about to embark on a journey of redemption as a death row inmate. A mysterious and dangerous dungeon awaits you, full of endless monsters. Can you escape and find your salvation?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866716/cb6928e47cef798848d679c4fb19f604207ee562.jpg[/img]

Atoners: The Lost Epoch is now part of the Steam Next Fest, offering a playable demo for you to try. In this demo version, you will experience dungeon combat, various fun weapon combinations, and a customizable home system.

[h3]You can also check out the pre-recorded game play video we prepared during the Next Fest.[/h3]

If you feel like Atoners: The Lost Epoch is what you’re looking for, consider adding the game to your wishlist. 🙇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2653870/_/

This demo is the first appearance of Atoners: The Lost Epoch, so there are still issues that need improvement. We also hope to get more feedback and suggestions from players, to help us make the game more enjoyable.

If you have any questions, please leave us a message below, or join our social channels to discuss with us!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/XYVeKzZemM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866716/66d4f214f8ae9353991bb46e4ba6858840401c53.png[/img][/url]

Wish you good luck in the journey of redemption!
